documentPurpose: Phase 3 Steps 6–9 development-only examples defining the common personalized RSVP question/form schema shape and finalized conditional/dependency behavior, synchronized through Phase 3 Step 14 with the finalized SMS production-enablement and privacy/security boundaries. The complete production question bank remains deferred to Phase 4.

documentationNotes.dietaryApplicability: Dietary information is applicable to any attending state (Ceremony only, Reception only, or both), remains optional, and is cleared only when the party fully declines.
documentationNotes.declinedAttendanceTotalsRepresentation: Attendance totals are inapplicable and omitted for a full decline rather than retained as a synthetic four-zero object.
documentationNotes.operationalConfirmationCopyStatus: provider-gated-final-rule: development examples may use provider-neutral placeholder text; production Text Message confirmation remains disabled until the selected provider's required disclosure/authorization wording is verified and implemented
documentationNotes.productionConfirmationOptionsRule: confirmationOptions.textMessage may be true in production only after the selected SMS provider, required guest-facing disclosure/authorization copy, backend-only credentials/sender configuration, and production-flow testing satisfy the finalized Phase 3 Step 14 gate
documentationNotes.transactionalMobileNumberUse: A confirmation mobile number is operational RSVP contact data used only for the requested transactional RSVP confirmation and approved manual resend unless a later recorded decision separately authorizes another use.

conditionLanguage.always: Boolean true means the question is always displayed when it belongs to the selected profile.
conditionLanguage.fieldEquals: Two-item array [questionId, expectedValue]; true when the current page-entered value equals expectedValue.
conditionLanguage.fieldNotEquals: Two-item array [questionId, disallowedValue]; true when the current page-entered value does not equal disallowedValue.
conditionLanguage.fieldHasAnySelection: Question ID whose current array value must contain at least one selection.
conditionLanguage.configurationEquals: Two-item array [configurationKey, expectedValue]; evaluated from the limited authorized configuration returned by the backend.
conditionLanguage.all: Array of conditions; every nested condition must be true.

validationExtensions.sumMinimumWhenApplicable: For an applicable number-group, the complete merged group sum must be at least this value.
validationExtensions.sumMaximumFrom: The complete merged number-group sum must not exceed the referenced authorized invitation value.
validationExtensions.effectiveAdditionalGuestCountMustNotExce: When true, the effective authorized additional-guest count must not exceed the complete merged attendance-total sum.

requirementsBeforeEnablement: Verify the provider's then-current required sender-identification, consent, carrier-rate, opt-out/help, and other applicable guest-facing language.
Store provider credentials and sender configuration only through the protected backend secret boundary.
Update the guest-facing smsAuthorization copy to the verified production wording.
Test the completed production Text Message confirmation flow.
textMessageConfirmation.whenGateIsNotSatisfied: Production confirmationOptions.textMessage must be false; do not render the Text Message choice or invent provider-specific disclosure language.
textMessageConfirmation.schemaShapeInvariant: The permanent confirmationMethod value textMessage and smsAuthorization question ID remain part of the reusable schema vocabulary even when the production channel is disabled.

dependencyRules.rule: Authorize request fields and operations, determine initial versus revision, merge submitted changes with stored values, preserve omissions, resolve attendance/decline, clear values made inapplicable by full decline, require newly applicable mandatory values, validate the complete result, then store only if valid.
A valid complete RSVP is either attending with one or more eventAttendance selections and declineAttendance=false, or declining with eventAttendance=[] and declineAttendance=true.
A complete RSVP must not contain both a nonempty eventAttendance array and declineAttendance=true.
An initial response must establish a valid attendance or decline state; eventAttendance=[] with declineAttendance=false is invalid.

When the complete resulting RSVP fully declines, eventAttendance becomes [], additionalGuestAttendance and attendanceTotals become inapplicable and are removed, and dietaryPreferences is cleared. Operational confirmation remains required.
dietaryPreferences is optional but applicable whenever the party attends Ceremony, Reception, or both. It is not Reception-only. A full decline clears it.

additionalGuestAttendance is applicable only for an attending default-profile RSVP with additionalGuestAllowance>0. It is required on an initial attending response and whenever it becomes newly applicable after a prior decline.
Allowance 1 uses yes/no. Allowance greater than 1 uses a whole number from 0 through additionalGuestAllowance. Allowance 0 and the reduced profile reject the field.
For an attending default-profile RSVP, the effective additional-guest count must not exceed overallAttendance because attendanceTotals represents the complete attending party.

attendanceTotals is applicable only to an attending default-profile RSVP. All four categories are required on an initial attending response and whenever the totals become newly applicable after a prior decline.
Each attendance-total category is a nonnegative whole number. overallAttendance is their server-calculated sum, must be at least 1 while attending, and must not exceed invitation.maximumAttendance.
For a revision that remains attending, omitted nested attendance-total categories remain unchanged and explicit zero is an ordinary replacement value.
Changing additionalGuestAttendance does not cause the backend to guess or automatically change an age-category total; the complete merged totals must independently validate.
The reduced-attendance-dietary profile accepts only attendance/decline and party-level dietary information. It never accepts additionalGuestAttendance or attendanceTotals.
For revisions, an omitted substantive field remains unchanged unless an authoritative controlling-state rule makes that stored field inapplicable.
confirmationMethod=email requires a valid newly entered confirmationEmail and makes confirmationMobile and smsAuthorization inapplicable.

confirmationMethod=textMessage requires a valid newly entered confirmationMobile, makes confirmationEmail inapplicable, and requires smsAuthorization=true only when centralized configuration requires transactional SMS authorization.

In production, confirmationMethod=textMessage is authorized only when centralized configuration reports that the Phase 3 Step 14 SMS-provider enablement gate is satisfied. Otherwise Text Message is not advertised in confirmationOptions and a submitted textMessage method is not accepted merely because the reusable development schema vocabulary contains that value.
React visibility and usability validation do not authorize a value. Express independently enforces profile, allowance, dependency, and complete-result rules.

questions.label: Event attendance

labelVariants.singular: I will be attending (check all that apply):
labelVariants.plural: We will be attending (check all that apply):

questions.helpText: Select Ceremony, Reception, or both for an attending state. For a revision, omission leaves the stored event selection unchanged; a full decline clears event selections.

questions.label: Unable to attend

labelVariants.singular: Regretfully, I am unable to attend.
labelVariants.plural: Regretfully, we are unable to attend.

questions.helpText: Attendance and decline are mutually exclusive. A revision may omit this field to leave the stored status unchanged; a resulting full decline clears attendance-dependent substantive data.

questions.label: To better accommodate the seating & dietary needs of our guests, please list the total number of attendees in your party:
questions.helpText: Required for an attending default-profile response. The four-category sum is the complete attending party, including additional guests, must be at least one, and must not exceed maximumAttendance. A full decline makes the totals inapplicable.

questions.label: Please list any food allergies or dietary preferences for the members of your party.
questions.helpText: One optional free-text response applies to the entire attending party. It is applicable to Ceremony-only, Reception-only, or combined attendance and is automatically cleared on full decline.

questions.label: Confirmation method
questions.helpText: Required for every initial submission and revision. Email requires a valid email destination. The reusable development schema includes Text Message, but production may render/accept it only when confirmationOptions reports that the Step 14 provider/disclosure gate is satisfied. When enabled, Text Message requires a valid SMS-capable mobile destination plus transactional authorization when configured. New operational values replace stored counterparts.

questions.label: Email address
questions.helpText: Required when Email is selected. The complete current RSVP will be sent to the newly entered address.

questions.label: SMS-capable mobile number
questions.helpText: Required when Text message is selected. The complete current RSVP will be sent to the newly entered mobile number.

questions.label: Transactional text-message authorization

options.label: I authorize the required transactional RSVP confirmation text message.

questions.helpText: Development-only provider-neutral placeholder. In production this control is rendered and required only when Text Message confirmation is enabled and the selected provider's verified disclosure/authorization wording applies. The permanent question ID remains smsAuthorization; do not invent provider-specific production copy before the Step 14 gate is satisfied.

formValidationRules.rule: A complete response must be either attending with Ceremony, Reception, or both and decline=false, or declining with no event selections and decline=true.
A complete RSVP must not simultaneously contain event attendance and a decline response.
Every initial submission and revision requires confirmationMethod plus the applicable newly entered destination and any required SMS authorization.

For substantive RSVP fields, omission on revision means leave the stored value unchanged unless a controlling full-decline result makes that field inapplicable. Replacement, explicit zero, and explicit clear remain distinct operations.

When the complete result is attending, attendanceTotals is required. Initial or newly applicable totals must include all four nonnegative whole-number categories; their sum must be at least 1 and must not exceed invitation.maximumAttendance.
For a revision that remains attending, omitted attendance-total categories remain unchanged and explicit zero is a replacement value.
This invitation has additionalGuestAllowance=0, so no additionalGuestAttendance question may be rendered or submitted.
dietaryPreferences is optional but applicable to Ceremony-only, Reception-only, or combined attendance. It is not Reception-only and is cleared when the complete result fully declines.
A fully declining result sets eventAttendance to an empty array, clears dietaryPreferences, and removes any applicable additionalGuestAttendance and attendanceTotals before final validation.

Email requires confirmationEmail and excludes confirmationMobile/smsAuthorization. Text Message requires confirmationMobile, excludes confirmationEmail, and requires smsAuthorization=true only when centralized configuration requires it.
Client visibility and usability validation do not authorize values; the backend independently applies all profile, allowance, dependency, and complete-result rules.
